name: Compound V3

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: a confirmed delay, bypass paths not all checked

narrative.summary: Governor, proxy admin and configurator all resolve to one LocalTimelock (1-day delay) whose admin is Compound’s ArbitrumBridgeReceiver, relaying Compound’s Ethereum-mainnet DAO timelock.
narrative.detail: Same shape as the Base Comet, re-derived live against roots.json. A 5-of-9 pauseGuardian Safe can pause outside the timelock (pause only, disclosed, not scored).

steps.what: the admin slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the word is the admin address
owner() on the address the slot returned (a ProxyAdmin): the holder
delay() on the holder (Compound-style timelock), in seconds
the implementation slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the code behind it, an upgrade changes this word

independent_read_reproduce.curl:
# the admin slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the word is the admin address
curl -s -X POST https://arb1.arbitrum.io/rpc -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getStorageAt","params":["0x9c4ec768c28520b50860ea7a15bd7213a9ff58bf","0xb53127684a568b3173ae13b9f8a6016e243e63b6e8ee1178d6a717850b5d6103","0x1ea1eec9"]}'
# owner() on the address the slot returned (a ProxyAdmin): the holder
curl -s -X POST https://arb1.arbitrum.io/rpc -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"<address from the slot>","data":"0x8da5cb5b"},"0x1ea1eec9"]}'
# delay() on the holder (Compound-style timelock), in seconds
curl -s -X POST https://arb1.arbitrum.io/rpc -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"0x3fb4d38ea7ec20d91917c09591490eeda38cf88a","data":"0x6a42b8f8"},"latest"]}'
# the implementation slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the code behind it, an upgrade changes this word
curl -s -X POST https://arb1.arbitrum.io/rpc -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getStorageAt","params":["0x9c4ec768c28520b50860ea7a15bd7213a9ff58bf","0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc","latest"]}'
independent_read_reproduce.note: read between blocks 513928889 and 513928905 of the chain

cheapest_fix.what: admin power taken away from a bare key

independent_read.posture: admin: a timelock; delay: 24 h on the timelock
